original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: Conditional 6U PIC profiles do not impose a universal physical chassis or a DIM root
The 6U payload choices differ: XMC system-specific I/O or additional Expansion plane, not one mandatory combined configuration
Explicit design 1000BASE-T Data Thin and 100BASE-T Control Ultra-Thin exits do not establish an installed Ethernet network, IP address or CSAPI transport

original_source_items.native_name: External I/O card versus real command execution
original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: A card may receive commands and return statuses by fabric design; no authenticated request/outcome/physical effect evidenced
RF/optical-rich profile marked new and limited deployment; name/source is no proof of deployed availability
Printed Ready, standard dates and legacy asterisk concern profile option metadata, not system state
Rule13.2.12-1 final table pointer, Table13.2.12.4-1 name/body, External I/O text crossreferences and Recommendation wording retained as printed
None of Dragino/AirGradient/Campbell/Bennett originals establishes a conformant 6U SOSA PIC, installed clock, chassis, deployment or device command

source_printed_discrepancies.detail: Fifth named 6U profile refers to Table13.2.12.2-3 although source contains Table13.2.12.4-1; no invented correction.
Caption names SLT6-PAY-4F2Q1H4U1T1S1S1T1U2U2T2H-10.6.5-n; internal table names a distinct SLT6-PAY-4F1Q1H4U1T1S1S1TU2U2T2H-10.6.5-n.
6U External I/O description refers to XMC mapping of §13.2.11.1 (3U I/O intensive), not obviously to §13.2.12.1; preserve source pointer.
Printed SHOULD favors Payload over External I/O when platform-specific I/O cannot be accommodated by a single XMC; don't reverse source wording.
Heading is 6U RF/Optical Switch PICP whereas figure caption identifies Payload Slot Profile; permitted transceiver/switch uses not conflated.
Aperture H 19 SMPS rows cite 6.4.5.6.6 vs 6.4.5.6.7 depending profile; original ANSI/VITA untouched, no universal reconciliation.

exact_holds.reason: Original ANSI/VITA 65.0/65.1, VITA 46.9 and referenced physical interface standards unexamined; source naming is not verification of native normative rule text
Eight original C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI companions still unreviewed; physical profile does not define their actual fields/endpoints
Five source figure captions/labels read; only four page images spotchecked, not precise high resolution pin/arrow/geometry verification
Specific ANSI/VITA 6U form factor, slots/backplanes and XMC do not constitute a mandatory general DIM containment model
Hardware plane 1000BASE-T/100BASE-T design exits, optical/coax and connectors not observed network endpoints or measured transmissions
External I/O intended command/status paths do not prove CSAPI request, authorization, ack, device effect or live telemetry
Ready/date/legacy marker in dash options is printed standard design metadata, not installation evidence or current supplier inventory
Rule 13.2.12-1 fifth profile points to Table13.2.12.2-3, whereas actual §13.2.12.4 uses Table13.2.12.4-1; retain unresolved original reference
Table13.2.12.4-1 caption says SLT6-PAY-4F2...T1U2U2T2H while internal table names SLT6-PAY-4F1...TU2U2T2H; original ambiguity retained
§13.2.12.3 cites §13.2.11.1 and Recommendation13.2.12.3-2 says to prefer payload PIC when one XMC cannot accommodate I/O; no editorial reversal invented
§13.2.12.4 describes a newer limited-deployment RF/optical application; no assumption of broadly available/fielded equipment
§13.2.13 Legacy starts on PDF249 and is not audited in G2-6C; no new rules/deprecation decisions attributed to this packet
No adopted final domain name, DIM class/cardinality, Profile SHALL, manufacturer conformance or runtime device operation
